# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "sphms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "sphms-theory.html",
    Implementation = "sphms-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "sphms-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "sphms-validation.html"
  )
)
```

SPHMS is checked against radial finite-element solutions for spherical boundary-value problems. The table set covers rigid, pressure-release, liquid-filled, and gas-filled spheres over frequency, orientation, radius, and material-property sweeps.

::: {.tip data-title="Reading the residuals"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical row-wise agreement. Maximum differences are retained because deep target-strength nulls can localize the largest dB residuals.
:::

## TS-Frequency

Frequency rows retain boundary, radius, orientation, and material
properties while sweeping frequency.
